description:
Sometimes the clue is sitting right there in the picture.

You know the moment: something feels a bit telling, so you take a closer look and trust your eye.

Caught You Looking is an easygoing picture quiz where each round gives you one illustration and one correct spot to pick.

・Read the prompt
・Scan the whole image carefully
・Use the buttons or tap where you think the answer is
・Pick one spot and check whether you nailed it

It is simple to jump into, but sharp eyes make all the difference. Miss one, and you will want another go straight away.

Great for a quick break when you feel like a small observation challenge.

Playable with button controls and touch controls.
